subject: DI04000321

body.en:
Definition

A synchronous machine is an AC machine whose rotor magnetic axis remains locked at a steady electrical load angle to the rotating stator field,so steady rotor speed equals120f/P.

Classification / scope

  • Rotor construction:salient-pole and cylindrical/non-salient rotor.Excitation:wound-field,permanent magnet or reluctance;not all need a DC field winding.

Construction / parts and their purpose

  1. Stationary laminated armature carries the three-phase distributed winding,allowing high output current/voltage connections without rotating load-current brushes.
  2. The wound-field rotor carries DC excitation through rings or a brushless exciter;field poles establish the rotor magnetic pattern.
  3. Salient poles project from a large-diameter rotor;cylindrical rotors have field conductors in slots and suit high mechanical speed.
  4. Damper bars where provided form shorted rotor circuits for damping and possibly induction starting;they are not the main DC field supply.
  5. Shaft,bearings,cooling,exciter,terminal/earth arrangements and protection must match the machine duty and overspeed limits.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • The same electromagnetic structure can generate or motor when mechanical/electrical power direction is changed within design limits.The course principally treats three-phase wound-field machines.

Read each definition first,then identify the machine family and stated model assumptions.Do not transfer a formula across incompatible connections or sign conventions.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Synchronous machine એવી AC machine છે જેમાં rotor magnetic axis rotating stator field સાથે steady electrical load angle પર lock રહે છે;તેથી steady rotor speed120f/P થાય છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Rotor construction:salient-pole/cylindrical;excitation:wound-field,permanent magnet/reluctance;બધામાં DC field winding હોતી નથી.

Construction / ભાગો તથા તેમનું કાર્ય

  1. Stationary laminated armatureમાં three-phase distributed winding હોય;high load V/I connections rotating load-current brushes વિના મળે.
  2. Wound-field rotorને rings/brushless exciterથી DC મળે;field poles rotor magnetic pattern બનાવે.
  3. Salient poles large-diameter rotorથી project થાય;cylindrical rotorમાં slotted field conductors/high-speed suitability છે.
  4. Damper bars હોય ત્યાં damping/possible induction startingના shorted circuits બનાવે;main DC field supply નહીં.
  5. Shaft,bearings,cooling,exciter,terminals/earth/protection duty/overspeed limits મુજબ હોય.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Design limitsમાં mechanical/electrical power direction બદલતાં સમાન structure generator/motor બની શકે.Course મુખ્ય three-phase wound-field machines લે છે.

પહેલાં વ્યાખ્યા વાંચી machine family તથા modelની ધારણાઓ ઓળખો.જુદાં connections/sign conventionsમાં formula અંધ રીતે નલગાડો.

h.en: Synchronous motor operation and why it cannot normally self-start
h.gu: Synchronous Motor Working તથા Self-starting કેમ નહીં?

body.en:
Definition

A synchronous motor converts AC electrical input to mechanical output through torque between its rotor field and the rotating stator field,remaining in synchronism while the permitted load angle is maintained.

Working / cause-and-effect sequence

  1. Apply the approved starting method and manage field-circuit induced voltage according to the machine design.
  2. Near synchronous speed,establish the specified excitation/switching sequence to pull the rotor into step.
  3. An increased load increases load angle rather than permanently increasing slip;excess load causes loss of synchronism.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • With a stationary excited rotor and fixed-frequency stator field,the alternating torque reverses too rapidly for normal acceleration;average starting torque of the ideal field interaction is zero.
  • Once brought near synchronous speed and correctly excited,the rotor can lock to the field and develop steady torque.The rotor field lags the stator resultant field in motoring.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Synchronous motor rotor/stator fields વચ્ચેના torqueથી AC electrical inputને mechanical outputમાં બદલે છે અને permitted load angle જળવાય ત્યાં synchronismમાં રહે છે.

Working / કારણ તથા પરિણામનો ક્રમ

  1. Approved starting methodથી શરૂ કરી design પ્રમાણે field induced voltage manage કરો.
  2. Near synchronous speed પર specified excitation/switchingથી rotorને stepમાં ખેંચો.
  3. Load વધતાં permanent slip નહીં પણ load angle વધે;વધુ load synchronism ગુમાવે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Stationary excited rotor/fixed-frequency fieldમાં torque ઝડપથી reverse થાય એટલે normal acceleration મળતું નથી;ideal field interactionનું average starting torque zero છે.
  • Near synchronous speed/યોગ્ય excitation પછી rotor lock થઈ steady torque આપે;motoringમાં rotor field stator resultant fieldથી lag રહે છે.

body.en:
Definition

The electrical load angle δ is the angle between terminal-voltage and internal-EMF phasors under a stated current/power convention;it represents the rotor field displacement needed to transfer real power.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • For the motor convention current enters the machine and E lags V by positive δ;for generator current leaves the machine and E leads V by positive δ.Do not copy one phasor sign rule into the other.
  • Electrical angle equals(P/2)times mechanical angle.The90°maximum below belongs to an ideal cylindrical-rotor,negligible-resistance model,not every salient machine.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Assume balanced cylindrical machine,per-phase RMS Vand E,constant excitation and negligible armature resistance with synchronous reactance Xs.
  2. Motor phasor equation is V=E+j Xs I.Projecting Ionto Vgives per-phase real power VE sinδ/Xs.
  3. Total developed power P≈3VE sinδ/Xs and torque Te=P/ωs;Pm ax≈3VE/Xs at δ=90°in this model.
  4. Stable small-signal operation requires positive synchronising power slope dP/dδ=(3VE/Xs)cosδ in the normal region;practical margins keep operation below the limit.

Worked numerical / interpretation

  1. For V=230 Vphase,E=200 Vphase,Xs=10Ωand δ=30°,P≈6.9 kW.At1500 rpm,Te≈43.93N·m,neglecting losses.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Electrical load angle δ stated conventionમાં terminal voltage/internal EMF phasors વચ્ચેનો angle છે;real power transfer માટેનું rotor-field displacement દર્શાવે છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Motorમાં current અંદર/E,Vથી positive δ lag;generatorમાં current બહાર/E,Vથી positive δ lead થાય.બંનેનાં sign rules mix નકરો.
  • Electrical angle=(P/2)×mechanical angle.નીચેનું90° maximum ideal cylindrical/negligible-R model માટે છે,દરેક salient machine માટે નહીં.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Balanced cylindrical machine,per-phase RMS V/E,constant excitation/negligible Ra તથા Xs ધારો.
  2. Motor equation V=E+j Xs I છે.Iને Vદિશામાં project કરતાં per-phase real power VE sinδ/Xs મળે.
  3. Total developed power P≈3VE sinδ/Xs તથા Te=P/ωs;આ modelમાં δ=90°પર Pm ax≈3VE/Xs.
  4. Normal regionમાં stability માટે positive dP/dδ=(3VE/Xs)cosδ જોઈએ;practical marginથી limitની નીચે operation રાખાય.

ઉકેલેલું Numerical / અર્થઘટન

  1. V=230 Vphase,E=200 Vphase,Xs=10Ω/δ=30°માં P≈6.9 kW.1500 rpm પર losses neglect કરતાં Te≈43.93N·m.

body.en:
Definition

Pull-in torque is the greatest specified load torque under which a starting synchronous motor can enter synchronism under defined inertia/excitation conditions;pull-out torque is the maximum steady torque it can sustain without falling out of step.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Starting torque is produced by the starting arrangement,not by assuming an already locked rotor.Running torque balances load/losses at the operating angle.
  • Pull-in depends strongly on inertia,load and switching conditions and is not simply another name for pull-out.Exceeding pull-out causes pole slipping,current pulsations and protective action.
  • A flat speed characteristic in synchronism means fixed steady speed,not unlimited torque or immunity to overload.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Pull-in torque defined inertia/excitationમાં starting motor synchronismમાં આવી શકે તે specified greatest load torque છે;pull-out torque synchronism ગુમાવ્યા વિના સહન કરાતું maximum steady torque છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Starting torque starting arrangementથી બને,પહેલેથી locked rotorની ધારણાથી નહીં.Running torque operating angle પર load/losses balance કરે.
  • Pull-in inertia,load/switching પર આધારિત છે,pull-outનું બીજું નામ નથી.Pull-outથી ઉપર pole-slip,current pulsations/protection થાય.
  • Synchronismમાં flat speed characteristic એટલે fixed steady speed;unlimited torque/overload immunity નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A V-curve plots armature current against field current at constant terminal voltage,frequency and stated mechanical load;an inverted V-curve plots power factor against field current under corresponding conditions.

Working / cause-and-effect sequence

  1. Start and synchronise the guarded motor using the approved procedure,set a permitted fixed load,then vary excitation only within its field/current limits.
  2. Record actual If,Ia,V,Pand PF,then repeat for another approved fixed load;mark leading/lagging explicitly.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Underexcitation normally gives lagging input current;near suitable excitation PF is near unity and armature current is near minimum;overexcitation produces leading input current.
  • For approximately constant real input,P≈√3 VL IL cosφ,so lower PF requires more current.Running losses vary with excitation,so the current minimum/unity-PF point is an approximate instructional correspondence.
  • At higher shaft load the V-curve lies higher and the optimum field usually shifts;do not compare different load curves as though real power stayed unchanged.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

V-curve constant terminal voltage,frequency/stated mechanical load પર armature current સામે field current બતાવે;inverted V-curve સમાન conditionsમાં PF સામે field current બતાવે.

Working / કારણ તથા પરિણામનો ક્રમ

  1. Approved procedureથી guarded motor start/synchronise કરી fixed permitted load સેટ કરો;field/current limitsમાં excitation બદલો.
  2. Actual If,Ia,V,P/PF નોંધો,બીજા fixed load માટે repeat કરો;leading/lagging સ્પષ્ટ લખો.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Underexcitationમાં સામાન્ય lagging input current;યોગ્ય excitation પાસે PF near unity/Ia near minimum;overexcitationમાં leading input current મળે.
  • Approximately constant real inputમાં P≈√3 VL IL cosφ હોવાથી PF ઘટતાં current વધે.Excitationથી losses બદલાય એટલે current minimum/unity-PF correspondence approximate છે.
  • વધુ shaft loadમાં V-curve ઊંચો/optimum field સામાન્ય shift થાય;જુદા loadsમાં real power સમાન માની compare નકરો.

body.en:
Definition

Synchronous-motor starting supplies an acceleration mechanism and a controlled transition into field locking,because ordinary fixed-frequency excitation alone does not provide sustained self-starting torque.

Classification / scope

  • Damper induction starting,auxiliary/pony motor and compatible variable-frequency starting are the principal methods;availability depends on rotor design.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Damper-cage start:run initially as an induction motor;manage the field winding through the specified discharge/shorting arrangement,and apply excitation near synchronism.Do not leave an unprotected field open during induction starting.
  • Pony-motor start:an auxiliary drive brings the rotor near the required speed before connection/synchronising;coupling and switching remain qualified tasks.
  • Variable-frequency start:the drive begins with a low rotating-field frequency and ramps it while controlling excitation/position as designed;this is not the same as a voltage-only soft start.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Synchronous-motor starting acceleration mechanism તથા controlled field-locking transition આપે છે કારણ કે માત્ર fixed-frequency excitation sustained self-starting torque આપતું નથી.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • મુખ્ય methods:damper induction,pony motor/compatible variable-frequency;availability rotor design પ્રમાણે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Damper startમાં પહેલાં induction motor તરીકે ચલાવો;fieldને specified discharge/shorting arrangementથી protect કરી near synchronism excitation આપો.Unprotected field open નરાખો.
  • Pony motor rotorને required speed પાસે લાવે પછી connection/synchronisation થાય;coupling/switching qualified task છે.
  • Variable-frequency startમાં low field frequencyથી designed excitation/position control સાથે ramp થાય;voltage-only soft startથી જુદું છે.

body.en:
Definition

Hunting is the oscillation of rotor electrical angle and speed about the synchronous equilibrium following a disturbance;the mean speed may remain synchronous while instantaneous speed varies.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Sudden load/excitation/supply changes disturb torque balance;rotor inertia overshoots the new angle and synchronising torque restores it,creating oscillation.
  • Damper circuits develop currents when the rotor oscillates relative to the field,and their torque opposes the relative motion.Alocked steady rotor ideally has no fundamental damper slip current.
  • Excessive hunting causes torque stress,current pulsations and possible pole slipping;reduce abrupt disturbances and use correctly tuned excitation/governor/drive damping,not arbitrary added inertia.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Hunting disturbance પછી synchronous equilibrium આસપાસ rotor electrical angle/speedનું oscillation છે;instantaneous speed બદલાય છતાં mean synchronous રહી શકે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Sudden load/excitation/supplyથી balance બદલાય;inertia નવા angleથી overshoot કરે/synchronising torque restore કરતાં oscillation થાય.
  • Relative oscillationથી damper current બને/torque motionનો વિરોધ કરે.Steady locked rotorમાં ideal fundamental damper slip current નથી.
  • વધુ huntingથી torque stress,current pulsations/pole slip થાય;disturbance ઘટાડો/યોગ્ય excitation-governor-drive damping વાપરો,મનસ્વી inertia નહીં.

title.gu: 3.8 Synchronous Condenser તથા Power-Factor Im provement

h.gu: Synchronous Condenser તથા Power-Factor Im provement

body.en:
Definition

A synchronous condenser is an overexcited synchronous machine operated with little useful shaft load to supply controllable reactive power while drawing real power to cover its losses.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • For motor input-current convention,overexcitation gives leading current and can offset a lagging installation reactive demand.It does not generate free real energy or eliminate the connected load’s real power.
  • Excitation/current/thermal and stability limits bound the reactive output.A synchronous motor driving useful load can also improve system PF within its capability.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. For a load real power P,initial Q1=P tanφ1and target Q2=P tanφ2where cosφ1/2are the stated PF values.
  2. Required leading compensation Qc=Q1−Q2=P(tanφ1−tanφ2).Select actual capability including machine losses and margins.

Worked numerical / interpretation

  1. For100 kW at0.8lagging corrected to0.95lagging,Qc≈42.13 kvar;the condenser still needs real-loss power and suitable protection.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Synchronous condenser ઓછી useful shaft load પર overexcited synchronous machine છે જે controllable reactive power આપે અને losses માટે real power લે છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Motor input conventionમાં overexcitation leading current આપી lagging reactive demand offset કરે;free real energy કે loadનું real power દૂર નથી કરતું.
  • Excitation/current/thermal/stability limits reactive output મર્યાદિત કરે.Useful load ચલાવતો synchronous motor પણ capabilityમાં PF સુધારી શકે.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Real power Pમાં Q1=P tanφ1 તથા target Q2=P tanφ2;cosφ1/2 stated PF છે.
  2. Required leading Qc=Q1−Q2=P(tanφ1−tanφ2).Machine losses/margins સાથે actual capability પસંદ કરો.

ઉકેલેલું Numerical / અર્થઘટન

  1. 100 kWને0.8laggingથી0.95lagging કરતાં Qc≈42.13 kvar જોઈએ;condenserને real-loss power/protection છતાં જરૂરી છે.

body.en:
Definition

An alternator is a synchronous generator that converts prime-mover mechanical input into AC electrical output by rotating a magnetic field relative to armature conductors.

Working / cause-and-effect sequence

  1. Establish the permitted excitation and rotate the guarded machine at the required speed.
  2. Changing flux linkages induces stator EMF;connected load current produces armature reaction and voltage drops.
  3. Control prime mover/excitation and protection to keep frequency,voltage,current and thermal limits within the rated duty.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • For a wound-field machine DC excitation establishes rotor flux;the prime mover rotates it,inducing three-phase stator EMFs120electrical degrees apart.
  • Generator electromagnetic torque opposes prime-mover rotation;mechanical input must cover electrical output plus losses.Excitation primarily affects voltage/reactive behaviour,not a free energy source.
  • In isolated operation governor action chiefly controls frequency and AVR controls voltage;on a strong grid mechanical input chiefly changes real power and excitation chiefly changes reactive power within limits.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Alternator synchronous generator છે જે armature conductorsસાપેક્ષ magnetic field ફેરવી prime-mover mechanical inputને AC electrical outputમાં બદલે છે.

Working / કારણ તથા પરિણામનો ક્રમ

  1. Permitted excitation સાથે guarded machine required speedે ફેરવો.
  2. Flux linkage changeથી stator EMF induce થાય;load current armature reaction/voltage drops આપે.
  3. Prime mover/excitation/protectionથી frequency,V,I/thermal limits rated dutyમાં રાખો.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Wound-field machineમાં DC excitation rotor flux બનાવે;prime mover ફેરવતાં statorમાં120electrical degrees અલગ three EMFs induce થાય.
  • Generator torque rotationનો વિરોધ કરે;mechanical input electrical output/losses પૂરા કરે.Excitation voltage/reactive behaviour બદલે,free energy source નથી.
  • Isolated operationમાં governor મુખ્ય frequency/AVR voltage નિયંત્રિત કરે;strong gridમાં mechanical input real power/excitation reactive powerને મુખ્ય અસર કરે.

body.en:
Definition

Turbo and hydro alternator designs adapt synchronous-generator rotor geometry,pole count and mechanical structure to the speed and torque of the associated turbine.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Steam/gas-turbine turbo alternators normally run at high speed with few poles and long,small-diameter cylindrical rotors to limit centrifugal stress.
  • Hydro turbines often run more slowly and use many salient poles on a larger-diameter,shorter rotor;mounting may be vertical or horizontal as designed.
  • These are common design trends,not a universal rule that every hydro machine has the same speed,pole count or mounting.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Turbo/hydro alternator designs turbineની speed/torqueને અનુકૂળ rotor geometry,poles/mechanical structure ધરાવે છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Steam/gas turbo alternators સામાન્ય high speed/few poles/long-small-diameter cylindrical rotor ધરાવે જેથી centrifugal stress મર્યાદિત રહે.
  • Hydro turbines ઘણીવાર ઓછી speedે ચાલે/large-diameter-short rotor પર ઘણા salient poles ધરાવે;mounting design મુજબ vertical/horizontal હોય.
  • આ common design trends છે;દરેક hydroની speed,poles/mounting સમાન હોય એવો નિયમ નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Generated electrical frequency is the number of alternating electrical cycles per second produced by rotor-pole passage past an armature phase.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • The relation applies to an alternator’s electrical output and a synchronous motor’s locked speed;induction rotor shaft speed includes slip.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. A pole pair gives one electrical cycle per mechanical revolution;with Ppoles,cycles/revolution=P/2.
  2. At N rpm,revolutions per second=N/60.Therefore f=(P/2)(N/60)=PN/120 Hz.
  3. Rearrange N=120f/Pand require an even practical pole count;speed/frequency must be stated in matching units.

Worked numerical / interpretation

  1. At50 Hz,a2pole turbo set runs3000 rpm,a4pole set1500 rpm,and a20pole hydro set300 rpm in synchronism.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Generated electrical frequency rotor poles armature phase પાસેથી પસાર થતાં દર secondમાં મળતા electrical cyclesની સંખ્યા છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Relation alternator frequency/synchronous motor locked speed માટે છે;induction shaft speedમાં slip હોય છે.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. એક pole pair એક mechanical revolutionમાં એક cycle આપે;P poles માટે cycles/revolution=P/2.
  2. N rpmમાં rev/s=N/60;તેથી f=(P/2)(N/60)=PN/120 Hz.
  3. N=120f/P કરો;practical poles even હોય/speed-frequencyનાં matching units રાખો.

ઉકેલેલું Numerical / અર્થઘટન

  1. 50 Hzમાં2pole turbo3000 rpm,4pole1500 rpm/20pole hydro300 rpm synchronismમાં ચાલે.

body.en:
Definition

A short-pitch coil spans less than180electrical degrees,so its two coil-side fundamental EMFs add vectorially to less than the full-pitch value;the ratio is pitch factor kp.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Short pitching can shorten end connections and suppress selected harmonics,but slightly reduces fundamental EMF.The harmonic factor is not always equal to the fundamental factor.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Let coil span=180°−ε,where εis the electrical chording angle;use electrical degrees consistently.
  2. The two equal side-EMF phasors have effective displacement εafter accounting for series coil polarity;resultant=2Eside cos(ε/2).
  3. Divide by full-pitch2Eside:kp=cos(ε/2).For harmonic order h,khp=cos(hε/2)with the stated polarity convention.

Worked numerical / interpretation

  1. For150°coil span,ε=30°and kp=cos15°≈0.9659;do not use cos75°.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Short-pitch coilનું span180electrical degreesથી ઓછું હોય;બંને sideના fundamental EMFsનો vector sum full-pitchથી ઓછો થાય;તેનો ratio kp છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Short pitchથી end connections/selected harmonics ઓછાં થઈ શકે,પણ fundamental EMF થોડું ઘટે.Harmonic factor fundamental જેટલો હંમેશાં નથી.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Coil span=180°−ε લો;ε electrical chording angle છે/electrical degrees consistent રાખો.
  2. Series coil polarity સાથે effective side-EMF displacement ε છે;resultant=2Eside cos(ε/2).
  3. Full-pitch2Esideથી divide કરતાં kp=cos(ε/2).Harmonic h માટે stated polarityમાં khp=cos(hε/2).

ઉકેલેલું Numerical / અર્થઘટન

  1. Coil span150°માં ε=30°/kp=cos15°≈0.9659 થાય;cos75°નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Distribution factor kd is the ratio of the vector sum of EMFs from distributed phase coils to their arithmetic sum,for the specified harmonic and winding grouping.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Distributing coils over slots improves waveform/space distribution but reduces fundamental resultant compared with in-phase concentrated coils.The simple formula assumes a regular integral-slot grouping.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. For Sslots,Ppoles and3phases,slots per pole per phase q=S/(3P);electrical slot angle β=180°P/S.
  2. The qequal coil EMF phasors separated by βform a geometric phasor series;their resultant magnitude is Ecoil sin(qβ/2)/sin(β/2).
  3. Divide by qEcoilto obtain kd=sin(qβ/2)/[q sin(β/2)].For a harmonic,replace βby hβwhen the grouping remains valid.

Worked numerical / interpretation

  1. For36slots,4poles,3phases:q=3,β=20°,kd=sin30°/[3sin10°]≈0.9598.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Distribution factor kd specified harmonic/grouping માટે distributed phase-coil EMFsના vector sumનો arithmetic sum સાથેનો ratio છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Coils slotsમાં distribute કરતાં waveform/space distribution સુધરે,પણ in-phase concentrated coils કરતાં fundamental sum ઓછો થાય.Simple formula regular integral-slot grouping માટે છે.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. S slots,P poles/3phases માટે q=S/(3P),electrical slot angle β=180°P/S.
  2. βથી અલગ q સમાન phasorsની geometric seriesનું resultant Ecoil sin(qβ/2)/sin(β/2) છે.
  3. qEcoilથી divide કરતાં kd=sin(qβ/2)/[q sin(β/2)].Valid groupingમાં harmonic માટે βને hβથી બદલો.

ઉકેલેલું Numerical / અર્થઘટન

  1. 36slots,4poles,3phasesમાં q=3,β=20°/kd=sin30°/[3sin10°]≈0.9598.

body.en:
Definition

A brushless excitation system supplies the main rotor field through a shaft-mounted AC exciter and rotating rectifier,avoiding main-field current transfer through brushes/slip rings.

Working / cause-and-effect sequence

  1. Voltage feedback is compared with the AVR reference;the controller adjusts exciter field within limits.
  2. Exciter AC is rectified on the shaft and establishes the main rotor DC field;main stator voltage responds under the actual load/network condition.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • AVR controls the exciter stationary field;the rotating exciter armature produces AC which rotating diodes rectify for the main rotor field.A PMG may supply AVR power but is not present on every system.
  • The main alternator stator remains the load-output winding.Brushless does not mean maintenance-free:diodes,insulation,connections,cooling and control sensing still need inspection.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Brushless excitation system shaft-mounted AC exciter/rotating rectifierથી main rotor fieldને DC આપે છે જેથી main field current માટે brushes/slip rings જરૂરી નરહે.

Working / કારણ તથા પરિણામનો ક્રમ

  1. Voltage feedback AVR reference સાથે compare કરી exciter field limitsમાં adjust થાય.
  2. Exciter AC shaft પર rectify થઈ main rotor DC field બનાવે;actual load/network મુજબ main stator voltage બદલાય.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • AVR exciter stationary field નિયંત્રિત કરે;rotating armatureનું AC rotating diodesથી main rotor માટે DC બને.PMG AVR power આપી શકે,બધામાં નથી.
  • Main alternator stator load-output winding રહે છે.Brushless એટલે maintenance-free નહીં:diodes,insulation,connections,cooling/sensing તપાસવા પડે.

body.en:
Definition

The alternator EMF equation gives the fundamental RMS generated EMF per phase from sinusoidal pole flux,electrical frequency,series turns and winding factors.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Φis useful flux per pole in webers,Tis series turns per phase,and kw=kp kdfor this regular winding model.Do not substitute total three-phase turns or line voltage directly.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. A conductor cuts total flux PΦper revolution.At N/60revolutions per second,average induced EMF magnitude per conductor=PΦN/60=2fΦ.
  2. For a sinusoidal waveform,RMS/average rectified value≈1.11;RMS per conductor≈2.22fΦ.
  3. One turn has two active conductors,so concentrated full-pitch RMS per turn≈4.44fΦ.
  4. Apply Tseries turns and factors:Ephase=4.44kp kd fΦT.For star VL=√3Ephaseat no load;for delta VL=Ephase.

Worked numerical / interpretation

  1. For f=50 Hz,Φ=0.05 Wb,T=100,kp=0.9659,kd=0.9598,Ephase≈1029.05Vand star no-load line≈1782.36Vusing these rounded factors.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Alternator EMF equation sinusoidal pole flux,frequency,series turns/winding factorsથી fundamental RMS generated per-phase EMF આપે છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Φ useful flux/pole Wbમાં,T series turns/phase તથા regular windingમાં kw=kp kd છે.Total three-phase turns/line voltage સીધાં substitute નકરો.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. એક conductor revolutionમાં PΦ flux cuts કરે;N/60 rev/sમાં average magnitude PΦN/60=2fΦ થાય.
  2. Sinusoidal waveformમાં RMS/rectified-average≈1.11 હોવાથી per-conductor RMS≈2.22fΦ.
  3. એક turnના બે active conductors હોવાથી full-pitch concentrated RMS/turn≈4.44fΦ.
  4. T series turns/factors સાથે Ephase=4.44kp kd fΦT.Star no-load VL=√3Ephase/delta VL=Ephase.

ઉકેલેલું Numerical / અર્થઘટન

  1. f=50 Hz,Φ=0.05 Wb,T=100,kp=0.9659,kd=0.9598માં rounded factorsથી Ephase≈1029.05V/star no-load line≈1782.36V.

body.en:
Definition

Armature reaction is the effect of armature-current magnetic field on the resultant main air-gap field;it is distinct from armature resistance and leakage flux.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • In the simplified generator convention,unity-PF current is mainly cross-magnetising,lagging current has a demagnetising component and leading current a magnetising component.The exact decomposition depends on angle/saliency/saturation.
  • Synchronous reactance Xs models leakage plus armature-reaction voltage effects under the adopted approximation;Xs=XL+Xa is not proof the effects are identical physical leakage paths.
  • Generator current leaving the machine:E=V+I(Ra+j Xs).Motor current entering:V=E+I(Ra+j Xs).Use per-phase RMS values and complex vectors,not scalar drops.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Armature reaction armature-current fieldની resultant main air-gap field પર થતી અસર છે;તે armature resistance/leakage fluxથી જુદી છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Simplified generator conventionમાં unity-PF મુખ્ય cross-magnetising,laggingમાં demagnetising/leadingમાં magnetising component હોય;exact decomposition angle,saliency/saturation પ્રમાણે.
  • Adopted approximationમાં Xs leakage/armature-reaction voltage effects model કરે;Xs=XL+Xa એટલે બંને એક જ physical leakage path નહીં.
  • Generator outgoing currentમાં E=V+I(Ra+j Xs);motor incomingમાં V=E+I(Ra+j Xs).Per-phase RMS/complex vectors લો,scalar drops નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Alternator voltage regulation is100(E0−VFL)/VFL,where E0 is the no-load terminal voltage reached after removing the stated load while speed and field current are maintained,and VFL is the corresponding loaded voltage.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • State load current,PF and leading/lagging condition.Regulation may be negative for some leading loads;it is not efficiency or a percentage referenced to E0.
  • Direct test:run at rated speed,establish permitted full-load condition and excitation,record voltage,then remove load under approved control while holding speed/field and record no-load voltage.AVR action must be deliberately managed.
  • Efficiency requires an energy boundary and measured input or defensible loss data.Including external field power twice,or omitting it when separately supplied,gives an incorrect efficiency.

Worked numerical / interpretation

  1. If VFL=400Vand E0=424Vat the same speed/field,regulation=6%.For E0=392Vand VFL=400V,it is−2%,not a mathematical error.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Alternator voltage regulation100(E0−VFL)/VFL છે;stated load દૂર કર્યા પછી speed/field current સમાન રાખતાં મળતું no-load voltage E0 તથા corresponding loaded voltage VFL છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Load current,PF/leading-lagging લખો.કેટલાક leading loadsમાં regulation negative હોઈ શકે;તે efficiency/E0સાપેક્ષ percentage નથી.
  • Direct testમાં rated speed/approved full load/excitation પર voltage લો;controlled load removal પછી speed/field સમાન રાખી no-load voltage લો.AVR actionને deliberate રીતે manage કરવું જરૂરી.
  • Efficiency માટે energy boundary/measured input અથવા valid losses જોઈએ.External field power double-count અથવા અલગ supply હોય છતાં omit કરવું ખોટું છે.

ઉકેલેલું Numerical / અર્થઘટન

  1. સમાન speed/fieldમાં VFL=400V/E0=424V હોય તો regulation6%;E0=392V/VFL=400Vમાં−2%થાય,mathematical error નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

The synchronous-impedance method estimates alternator regulation using per-phase open-circuit EMF and short-circuit current at the same field current and speed,with measured armature resistance.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • OCC shows no-load voltage against If at rated speed and saturates;SCC shows short-circuit current against If and is approximately linear over the normal test region.Use paired points at the same If.
  • High-power short-circuit tests are protected laboratory operations,not a proposal to short a live grid terminal.The excitation starts from its approved minimum and current must remain within the test limit.
  • The EMF method often gives a pessimistic regulation estimate because saturation and armature reaction are lumped into a reactance.Use it as an approximation,not a universal exact prediction.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Convert measured OCC voltage/current to phase values for the actual connection;Zs=Eoc,phase/Isc,phaseat the same If and N.
  2. With temperature-corrected appropriate Ra,Xs=√(Zs²−Ra²);if Zs<Ra,the data/connection assumptions are inconsistent.
  3. For lagging I=I(cosφ−j sinφ),E=V+I(Ra+j Xs);for leading change the imaginary-current sign.Evaluate |E|vectorially.
  4. Finally regulation=100(|E|−V)/Vwith per-phase V.The ratio matches the line-voltage ratio only when the connection is consistently handled.

Worked numerical / interpretation

  1. For V=230 Vphase,I=10A,PF=0.8lagging,Ra=0.5Ω,Xs=5Ω,E=(264+j37)V,|E|≈266.580V,and regulation≈15.90%.

Reliability checks and limitations

  • OCC and SCC alone do not establish efficiency.Core,mechanical,copper,stray/excitation loss or measured-input information is additionally required.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Synchronous-impedance method સમાન field current/speed પરના per-phase open-circuit EMF,short-circuit current/measured resistanceથી regulation estimate કરે છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • OCC rated speed પર V–If/saturation બતાવે;SCC normal test regionમાં આશરે linear I–If આપે.સમાન Ifનાં paired points લો.
  • High-power SCC protected laboratory operation છે,live grid terminal short કરવાની સલાહ નહીં.Excitation approved minimumથી/current test limitમાં જ.
  • Saturation/armature reaction lump થતાં EMF method ઘણીવાર pessimistic regulation આપે;તે approximation છે,universal exact prediction નહીં.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Actual connection મુજબ phase V/I લો;સમાન If/Nમાં Zs=Eoc,phase/Isc,phase.
  2. યોગ્ય temperature-corrected Ra સાથે Xs=√(Zs²−Ra²);Zs<Ra હોય તો data/connection assumptions ખોટાં છે.
  3. Lagging I=I(cosφ−j sinφ) માટે E=V+I(Ra+j Xs);leadingમાં imaginary sign બદલો.|E| vectorially ગણો.
  4. અંતે per-phase Vથી regulation=100(|E|−V)/V કરો.Connection consistent હોય ત્યારે line ratio સમાન મળે.

ઉકેલેલું Numerical / અર્થઘટન

  1. V=230 Vphase,I=10A,PF=0.8lagging,Ra=0.5Ω/Xs=5Ωમાં E=(264+j37)V,|E|≈266.580V/regulation≈15.90%.

વિશ્વસનીયતા માટે ચકાસણી તથા મર્યાદા

  • માત્ર OCC/SCCથી efficiency નથી મળતી.Core,mechanical,copper,stray/excitation loss અથવા measured input પણ જોઈએ.

h.en: Armature resistance,phase conversion and efficiency boundary
h.gu: Armature Resistance,Phase Conversion તથા Efficiency Boundary

body.en:
Definition

Armature resistance used in a regulation/loss calculation must be the resistance per phase at a stated operating temperature and appropriate AC/DC test interpretation,not an unexplained line-to-line meter value.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • For equal winding resistances measured between two terminals:star Rph=RLL/2;closed delta Rph=3RLL/2.These follow series/parallel paths and require isolated,appropriate measurement.
  • DC resistance needs conductor-temperature correction;additional effective AC effects depend on construction/frequency.Ablanket multiplier without a stated method is not a measurement.
  • For OCC/SCC:star Vph=VL/√3,Iph=IL;delta Vph=VL,Iph=IL/√3.Use the same If and speed to form Zs.
  • For generator efficiency,total input includes mechanical input and any separately supplied excitation not already counted.If the shaft also drives the brushless exciter,do not add that same internal transfer again.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Regulation/lossમાં લેવાતો armature resistance stated temperature/યોગ્ય AC-DC interpretationવાળો per-phase resistance હોવો જોઈએ,અસ્પષ્ટ line-to-line value નહીં.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Equal windingsના two-terminal testમાં star Rph=RLL/2;closed delta Rph=3RLL/2.Series/parallel pathsથી આ મળે;isolated appropriate measurement જોઈએ.
  • DC resistanceમાં temperature correction જોઈએ;effective AC effect construction/frequency પ્રમાણે છે.Stated method વિના blanket multiplier measurement નથી.
  • OCC/SCCમાં star Vph=VL/√3,Iph=IL;delta Vph=VL,Iph=IL/√3.Same If/speedથી Zs લો.
  • Generator efficiencyમાં mechanical input તથા અગાઉ નગણાયેલી external excitation input લો.Shaft brushless exciter પણ drive કરતો હોય તો internal transfer ફરી ઉમેરવો નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Synchronisation is the process of matching an incoming alternator electrical state to an energised bus before its breaker closes,so the machines can be paralleled without unacceptable circulating current or torque shock.

Working / cause-and-effect sequence

  1. Qualified personnel verify isolation plan,ratings,phase sequence,earthing,governor/AVR and protective interlocks before the machine is run.
  2. With the incoming breaker open,bring voltage/frequency close and observe approved synchronising instruments;compensate only as the panel procedure specifies.
  3. Only authorised operation through verified synchronism-check permits closure;then load is transferred gradually within limits and genuine readings recorded.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Required conditions:correct phase sequence,nearly equal voltage magnitude,nearly equal frequency and appropriate near-zero phase-angle difference at actual contact closure;waveform compatibility/protection must also be adequate.
  • Wrong sequence cannot be corrected by waiting for a synchroscope position.Voltage mismatch drives reactive circulation;angle/frequency mismatch causes torque and real-power transients.
  • A lamp panel and synchroscope indicate conditions only with verified wiring and ratings.Sync-check relay,breaker closing-time allowance,reverse-power and electrical/mechanical protection remain essential.
  • After paralleling on a strong bus,prime-mover input changes real load sharing and excitation changes reactive sharing.Do not expect governor adjustment to freely change the grid frequency.

Reliability checks and limitations

  • An infinite bus is an ideal large-system model with essentially fixed voltage/frequency,not a physically infinite energy source or an instruction for unsupervised grid connection.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Synchronisation incoming alternatorને energised busની electrical state સાથે breaker close પહેલાં match કરવાની પ્રક્રિયા છે જેથી unacceptable circulating current/torque shock વિના parallel operation થાય.

Working / કારણ તથા પરિણામનો ક્રમ

  1. Qualified personnel running પહેલાં isolation plan,ratings,sequence,earthing,governor/AVR/interlocks verify કરે.
  2. Incoming breaker open રાખી V/f નજીક લાવો/approved instruments જુઓ;panel procedure પ્રમાણે જ compensate કરો.
  3. Verified sync-checkથી authorised closure પછી જ limitsમાં gradual load transfer/actual readings લેવાય.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • જરૂરી conditions:correct phase sequence,near-equal voltage/frequency તથા actual closure સમયે યોગ્ય near-zero phase angle;waveform compatibility/protection પણ જરૂરી.
  • Wrong sequence synchroscope positionની રાહથી સુધરતી નથી.Voltage mismatch reactive circulation તથા angle/frequency mismatch torque/real-power transients આપે.
  • Verified wiring/ratingsમાં જ lamps/synchroscope યોગ્ય indication આપે.Sync-check relay,breaker timing,reverse-power/protection જરૂરી છે.
  • Strong bus પર paralleling પછી prime mover real load sharing/excitation reactive sharing બદલે;governorથી grid frequency મનસ્વી બદલાતી નથી.

વિશ્વસનીયતા માટે ચકાસણી તથા મર્યાદા

  • Infinite bus essentially fixed V/fવાળું ideal large-system model છે,physically infinite source/unsupervised grid-connection instruction નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A synchronous-machine specification defines rated electrical output/input,excitation,mechanical speed,duty,cooling and performance/protection limits for its intended motor or generator service.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Generator rating is commonly kVA at a stated PF,voltage,frequency,temperature rise and cooling condition;motor rating commonly states useful shaft kW.Do not replace kVA with kW without PF and loss considerations.
  • IEC 60034series and relevant Indian adopted IS/IEC standards cover rotating-machine rating/tests;large turbine-driven generators have additional specific requirements.NEMA MG1 is another standards family with its own scope.
  • Frame dimensions,mounting IM,cooling IC,protection IP,insulation,overspeed,excitation and short-circuit capability require explicit entries.Aframe number is not a complete mechanical interchangeability guarantee.
  • IEefficiency classes apply only within the cited motor standard scope;do not automatically stamp an alternator IE3/IE5 because an induction-motor table uses those labels.Refer to tested generator efficiency/loss methods and the actual specification.
body.gu:

Aim and actual-work status

A supervised source-listed performance guide;no experiment,reading or teacher signature is claimed as completed.

Construction / parts and their purpose

  1. Approved synchronous motor/condenser panel,lagging test load and three-phase P/Q/PF instruments.
  2. Approved motor and lagging load on measured laboratory bus;system P/Qmetering and protected field control. Verify actual terminals with the instructor;role diagrams are not permission for live wiring.

Working / cause-and-effect sequence

  1. Review exact ratings,approved circuit,instruments,load limits and stop plan before any work;inspection-only exercises stay isolated.
  2. Isolate,lock out,prove dead and verify capacitor/field/DC bus stored energy safe as applicable;inspect guards,earthing and meter ranges.
  3. Establish safe synchronism and lagging load;record baseline P/Q/PF.Adjust excitation within capability,observe compensating leading reactive current and system values,then return controls safely.
  4. Only after instructor approval energise the guarded authorised setup;record actual stable values with units,conditions and evidence.Never insert expected numbers into actual columns.
  5. Return controls/load to the approved safe state,stop and isolate,verify stored energy safe,then prepare calculations/plots and explain discrepancies.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Official CO3;suggested.The source specifies no individual duration;leave actual date,time and evidence blank.

Worked numerical / interpretation

  1. Qc=P(tanφ1−tanφ2);separate useful load Pfrom added machine losses.Avoid unnecessary leading overcompensation and compare measured system totals.

Reliability checks and limitations

  • Condenser reactive support is limited by stator/field heating and stability,not just a desired PF number.
  • Fault isolation:stop safely on unexpected heating,current,noise or trip;check supply/connection,load,excitation and instruments under the required isolation.Never bypass interlocks;never open an energised CTsecondary.

q.en: Synchronous motor slip at steady lock?

a.en: Zero mean slip;transient hunting can still vary instantaneous speed/angle.
a.gu: Mean slip zero;transient huntingમાં instantaneous speed/angle બદલાય.

q.en: Pull-in versus pull-out?

a.en: Capture capability during starting differs from maximum sustainable steady locked torque.
a.gu: Starting capture capability/maximum steady locked torque જુદા છે.

q.en: V-curve controlled conditions?

a.en: Te rminal voltage,frequency and stated mechanical load.

q.en: Overexcited motor current?

a.en: Normally leading input current within its capability limits.
a.gu: Capability limitsમાં સામાન્ય leading input current.

q.en: Condenser real power zero?

a.en: No;it draws power to cover losses although useful shaft output is small.
a.gu: નહીં;useful shaft output ઓછો છતાં losses માટે real power લે.

q.en: Hydro rotor typical shape?

a.en: Many salient poles on a relatively large-diameter lower-speed rotor;actual design varies.
a.gu: Lower-speed/large-diameter rotor પર ઘણા salient poles;actual design બદલાય.

q.en: Pitch factor angle?
Turn count in EMF equation?

a.en: Series turns per phase,not all three-phase turns summed.

q.en: Generator phasor sign?

a.en: For current leaving the terminals,E=V+I(Ra+j Xs).
a.gu: Current બહાર જાય તે conventionમાં E=V+I(Ra+j Xs).

q.en: OCC/SCC pair at same what?

a.en: Field current and speed,with correctly converted phase voltage/current.
a.gu: Field current/speed તથા correctly converted phase V/I.

q.en: Can OCC/SCC alone give efficiency?

a.en: No;input or adequate loss data are also required.

q.en: Four synchronising conditions?

a.en: Sequence,voltage,frequency and phase angle at actual closure,with rated protection/waveform compatibility.
a.gu: Sequence,V,f/actual closure phase angle તથા protection/waveform compatibility.

q.gu: Construction તથા Salient/Cylindrical Turbo/Hydro compare કરો.
